description: This file defines the 'EmpPicture' entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It models the employee picture data, including image content, filename, type, size, and dimensions. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database and includes constants for allowed image types and extensions. The class associates with an Employee entity and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmpPicture
classes.description: Entity class representing the employee picture, including image data and metadata, with ORM mappings and decorator trait.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns an instance of the EmpPictureDecorator associated with this entity.
